title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Shadow
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：eagle　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eagle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my grandfather ① watched an eagle that no hunter on the cliff would have named, and he said the watching was the whole of the summer. The ② eagle, meaning the bird and not the emblem, flew fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; an eagle, he said, is the only thing on a cliff that is judged by how long it is left unwatched.

Every ③ eagle on that cliff had the same short shadow at the foot of it, and the ④ eagle at the end, meaning the one they kept for the hunt and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An eagle, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to watch; my grandfather said the watching is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the eagle was the whole of the story, meaning the emblem and not the bird. The ⑥ eagle, meaning the emblem and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody wears and nobody explains; eagle, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a bird and an emblem. He said the emblem is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ eagle had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short shadow. The ⑧ eagle of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in July, was one cliff and fourteen summers of watching; eagle, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to watch. She said the watching was never mentioned.

The ⑨ eagle I remember is the one named in the record, which left in 1971 and is still described as the quietest on the cliff. An ⑩ eagle, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being watched; every eagle, she said, is an emblem that has agreed to look like a bird. She said the emblem was the honest half.

answers.why: watch an eagle 意为“观察一只鹰”，1950 年祖父观察了一只崖上没有一位猎人肯叫出名字的鹰。
eagle 意为“鹰”，指那只鹰本身而不是鹰徽，它飞了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
eagle 意为“鹰”，指那面崖上的每一只鹰，每一只脚底下都有同一道短短的影子。
eagle 意为“鹰”，指留给猎场的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
eagle 意为“鹰徽、鹰形标志”，指故事里人人都佩戴却无人解释的那样东西，叔叔说这枚鹰徽就是那个故事的全部。
eagle 意为“鹰徽”，指人人都佩戴却无人解释的那种标志而不是那只鹰，是故事里人人都佩戴、却无人解释的东西。
eagle 意为“鹰”，指记录簿上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1959 年这只鹰成了记录簿里的一行。
eagle 意为“鹰”，祖父七月写道，整件事的观鹰之事是一面崖和十四个夏天的观察。
eagle 意为“鹰”，我记得的是记录簿上列名的那一只，1971 年飞走了，至今仍被说成崖上最安静的一只。
eagle 为抽象总称，祖母 1973 年说，一只鹰是唯一会因为被好好观察而变得更好的生灵。
